description.value: You target an object you can see within range that is held closed by a mundane or enhanced fastening, such as a locked door, chest, or set of binders. A mundane lock, bar, or obstruction on the target is undone; only one lock opens if the object has several. If the object is instead secured by the *lock* power, that power's effect is suppressed for 10 minutes, during which the object opens and closes normally.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
